answer: Require every agent to post a refundable economic bond before it can transact, with reputation hardening slowly over time like sediment compacting into basalt. A sybil swarm cannot cheaply mint thousands of such bonds, and freshly forged identities lack the long verified history that stretches back past the honest-agent horizon. Genuine agents keep flowing like a steady river of attested activity, while fakes dry up because the cost of faking that depth outweighs any short-term gain.
